## What

`KUBO_Booklet_EN.pdf`, the A4 booklet, rebuilt on a Mac from the sources in #30 (page 10 with the community photo banner and sticker).

It is the third of the three booklet PDFs. The two A5 files are in #31; all three together were too large for one request. Merge alongside #30 and #31.

## Checked

16 pages, A4, no fonts left (text is outlines), photos visible in Preview, page 10 rendered with photo, text and sticker in place.
params.title: Booklet: rebuilt A4 PDF with the community banner
